learnings.title: Cross-asset ETF flow divergence must not be labeled broad altcoin rotation
learnings.claim: On 19 October 2026 Farside Investors reported +526.7 million USD of net U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF flows and -103.3 million USD of net U.S. spot Ethereum ETF flows; one asset-class inflow does not establish broad crypto or altcoin demand.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_ETF_CROSS_ASSET_GATE: Verify each ETF asset class separately, fund-level row completeness and observation date; compare same-session BTC and ETH ETF flows before inferring rotation. A positive BTC ETF net flow does not prove ETH or broad altcoin demand. Mark provisional/incomplete rows and recheck revisions.
learnings.next_measurement: At next report compare Oct 19 Farside fund-level BTC and ETH flows with revised daily rows and ETH/BTC, altseason breadth; do not treat one session as persistent trend.
failure_history: Earlier Finance reports could conflate BTC ETF recovery with broad altcoin risk-on despite simultaneous ETH ETF outflows.
fallback_history: If Farside is unavailable, use issuer official flow/AUM releases or another independently checked fund-level flow provider; otherwise ETF flow N/A.
